description:
A beautifully presented and spacious two-double-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment ideally situated within the highly regarded Knockmaree development in Chapelizod.

Offering an excellent standard of accommodation throughout, this impressive apartment combines generous proportions, excellent natural light, a private balcony and secure underground parking, creating a particularly attractive rental home in one of Dublin 20’s most convenient locations.

The apartment opens into a welcoming entrance hallway with attractive contemporary finishes and useful storage. At the heart of the property is a bright, exceptionally spacious open-plan living and dining room, with large timber-framed windows and balcony doors that let in abundant natural light. The generous proportions provide ample space for comfortable everyday living and entertaining, while the private balcony offers a wonderful additional outdoor area with elevated views over the surrounding area and mature greenery.

The adjoining kitchen is both stylish and practical, featuring a good range of timber-effect wall and floor units for excellent storage, along with integrated appliances including an oven and hob, dishwasher, and microwave. It also includes a washing machine and a useful breakfast bar, creating a well-equipped kitchen that works seamlessly with the main living space.

The apartment offers two genuine double bedrooms, both generously proportioned and finished in neutral tones. Each bedroom features extensive built-in wardrobes, attractive wood-effect flooring, and excellent natural light. The principal bedroom offers a particularly comfortable, peaceful retreat, while the second double bedroom provides excellent flexibility and generous storage.

Two bathrooms further enhance the apartment, with a well-appointed main bathroom featuring a bath and shower, plus a separate shower room. Both are finished in neutral tones and provide excellent convenience for modern living.

Throughout the apartment, the combination of wood-effect flooring, neutral décor, contemporary lighting, generous storage and large windows creates a bright, warm and sophisticated interior. The property is in very good condition and offers a comfortable, stylish standard of rental accommodation.

Knockmaree is an established, well-maintained development set within landscaped communal grounds, providing a peaceful residential setting while remaining exceptionally convenient to Dublin City. The property also benefits from secure underground designated parking, an increasingly valuable feature in such a well-connected Dublin location.

The location is a particular highlight. Chapelizod Village is within easy walking distance and offers a selection of cafés, restaurants, pubs, local shops and everyday amenities, while the magnificent Phoenix Park is also close by, providing an outstanding setting for walking, running, cycling and enjoying the extensive parkland.

The apartment also benefits from excellent transport and road connections, with regular bus services providing convenient access towards Dublin City Centre and surrounding areas. The N4 and M50 are readily accessible, making the property particularly convenient for commuters travelling throughout Dublin and beyond.

134 Knockmaree offers an excellent opportunity to rent a spacious and beautifully presented two-double-bedroom apartment, ideally situated within this mature and highly regarded development in Chapelizod. The property combines generous and well-proportioned living accommodation with two bathrooms, private outdoor space and the particularly rare benefit of two designated car parking spaces positioned side by side within a secure underground car park

Two dedicated spaces are an exceptional advantage for an apartment and add significant convenience and value, particularly for tenants requiring more than one vehicle. The property enjoys an enviable location close to a host of local amenities, transport links and recreational facilities, offering an excellent balance of space, security, convenience and accessibility.

134 Knockmaree offers a superb opportunity to rent a spacious, beautifully presented two-double-bedroom apartment in a mature, highly regarded development, combining generous living accommodation, two bathrooms, private outdoor space, secure underground parking, and an enviable Chapelizod location.

Viewing is highly recommended.
